description: Passive/SPAN counterpart to case02: the same undocumented IT-to-SCADA flow, this time captured by the core switch tap rather than the DMZ appliance's own logs, since the rogue path uplinks through that same switch. Tests whether the verdict for Clause 1 holds regardless of which collection method surfaced the flow.

flows.notes: PLANTED VIOLATION: identical undocumented flow to case02, now seen from the core switch tap. No permit rule in either the DMZ appliance's policy or switch_acl_baseline.acl explains a direct IT host reaching 10.30.0.10 on port 502.
